'''Max''' (Japanese: '''マサト''' ''Masato'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG049|Maxxed Out!]]''. He is a [[doppelgänger]] of [[Max]] and as such shares the same name, both in English and Japanese, and character design.
[[File:AG049.png|thumb|left|250px|Max and [[Max|his doppelgänger]]]]
He confronted the group at a lakeside [[Pokémon Center]], demanding they keep it down after [[May's Skitty]] was proving too energetic. The blue-haired [[Max]] replied back, and an argument quickly broke out. Tensions between the pair quickly escalated after they realized they were both named Max. [[Nurse Joy]] broke it up, so Max went down to the lake to clear his head. 

Later, May and Max followed after a wild {{p|Surskit}} directly to the brown-haired Max's location. Another fight started, though {{an|Brock}} and the others called out their Pokémon as a distraction tactic. The two Max began to bond over their common love for Pokémon. Blue-haired Max then said he got to see them every day, and that [[Norman|his father]] is a [[Gym Leader]], making the other Max impressed.

May showed off Skitty to {{AP|Treecko}} and {{AP|Pikachu}}. Soon thereafter, {{TRT}} jumped from the bushes and surprised everyone. After their [[team Rocket's mechas|mecha]] exploded, sending Team Rocket blasting off, the two Max became friends. The brown-haired one intended to train his new friend {{p|Surskit}} hard, and one day become a [[Pokémon Trainer]].

Jessie's rage fueled Team Rocket next attempt, and Surskit was up against {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}} and [[James's Cacnea]]. Jessie resorted to trying to wrestle Surskit out of Max's hands, but [[May's Skitty]] {{m|Double Slap}}ped her in the face before [[Ash's Pikachu]] sent Team Rocket blasting off.
